invite.supplier: {buyer} has invited you to Mapema to get paid early on approved invoices. Join: {link}
invite.user: You have been invited to Mapema. Set up your account: {link}
invoice.eligible: Invoice {invoice} from {buyer} is confirmed. You can now request early payment.
advance.approved: Advance for invoice {invoice} approved, awaiting release.
advance.funded: Mapema has sent {amount} for invoice {invoice} to your account ending {last4}. Ref {ref}.
advance.release_failed: We could not pay out invoice {invoice}: {reason}. Our team will contact you.
notice.assignment: Notice of assignment: invoice {invoice} ({amount}) from {supplier} has been assigned to Mapema. Pay the full amount on {due} into account {account}.
payment.receipt.buyer: Receipt: we received {amount} on {date} for invoice {invoice}. Thank you.
settlement.balance_proposed: Your buyer paid invoice {invoice}. Your balance of {amount} is being released today.
payout.balance_sent: Mapema has sent your balance of {amount} for invoice {invoice}. Ref {ref}.
late.d1_reminder: Reminder: invoice {invoice} ({amount}) was due on {due}. Please pay into account {account}.
complaint.ack: We have received your complaint {ref}. We will respond by {due}.
dispute.opened: A buyer has raised a dispute on invoice {invoice}. Review it in the staff portal.
dsr.received: New data subject request {ref}. Statutory clock is running.
recon.break: Reconciliation for {date} has breaks. Review before releasing payouts.
advance.recourse: Invoice {invoice} is now under recourse. Please contact Mapema.
shortfall.opened.supplier: Your buyer paid {paid} against invoice {invoice} of {invoice_amount}. Mapema has been repaid; {amount} is still owed to you by the buyer. Please follow up with them directly - any further payment they make to the collection account will be passed to you.
shortfall.opened.buyer: Invoice {invoice}: you have paid {paid} of {invoice_amount}. {amount} is still owed to your supplier. Pay it to your usual collection account quoting {invoice}.
shortfall.settled.supplier: The buyer has now paid the remaining balance on invoice {invoice}. Nothing more is owed to you on it.
credit.review_due: Credit review needed: {what} for {org} is due on {date} ({when}). Open Mapema > Credit > Review tasks.
reminder.pre_due: Reminder: invoice {invoice} ({amount}) is due on {due}. Please pay the full amount into Mapema account {account}, reference {invoice}.
reminder.due: Invoice {invoice} ({amount}) is due today, {due}. Please pay into Mapema account {account}, reference {invoice}.
reminder.overdue: Invoice {invoice} ({amount}) was due on {due} and is {days} days overdue. Please pay into Mapema account {account}, reference {invoice}, or call us to agree a date.
reminder.supplier_warning: Your buyer has not yet paid invoice {invoice} (due {due}, {days} days overdue). Under your agreement Mapema may ask you to repay the advance if it stays unpaid. We will contact you first.
recourse.demand: Invoice {invoice} is unpaid {days} days after its due date. Under your master agreement please repay {amount} into Mapema account {account}, reference {invoice}. Call us if you want to agree a plan.
recourse.case_due: Advance for invoice {invoice} is {days} days past due. A recourse decision is needed (maker-checker).
collections.npl: Advance for invoice {invoice} is now non-performing ({days} days past due). The in duplum cap now applies.
recon.unexplained: Reconciliation for {date}: {count} unexplained break(s). Review and resolve in the staff portal before releasing payouts.
accounting.push_failed: Daily accounting journal for {date} was not pushed: {reason}.
